defs.def: to lean, or make sth lean, in a particular direction 尤指人的身体或头部

ex.s: Bent over my laptop while sitting on the bed in the corner of my room, I suddenly felt a pounding headache, and had to lie down.
ex.t: 我趴在笔记本电脑前，坐在房间角落的床上，突然感到一阵剧烈的头痛，不得不躺下。

ex.s: He bent down to hug his old friend goodbye.
ex.t: 他弯下腰，拥抱老朋友道别。

defs.def: if you bend your arm, leg, etc. or if it bends, you move it so that it is no longer straight （使四肢等）弯曲

ex.s: As the story goes, Lord Macartney refused for his ___34___ to do more than bend their knees.
ex.t: 据说，马戛尔尼勋爵拒绝让他的____（臣子）下跪磕头（弯膝）超过……

ex.s: The archer sees the mark upon the path of the infinite, and He bends you with His might that His arrows may go swift and far.
ex.t: 弓箭手看到了无限之路上的目标，祂用祂的力量将你弯曲，好让祂的箭飞得又快又远。

ex.s: Let your bending in the archer's hand be for gladness; For even as He loves the arrow that flies, so He loves also the bow that is stable.
ex.t: 让你在弓箭手手中的弯曲成为喜悦；因为正如祂爱那飞出的箭，祂也同样爱那稳固的弓。

ex.s: Objects such as planets and stars bend this fabric, creating the force we know as gravity.
ex.t: 行星和恒星等物体弯曲了这种结构，形成了我们称之为引力的力量。

defs.def: to force sth that was straight into an angle or a curve 把 … 弄弯（或折起）
to change direction to form a curve or an angle; to make sth change direction in this way （使）拐弯，弯曲

ex.s: If current trends don’t bend, Russia’s population will be about the size of Yemen’s by the year 2050.
ex.t: 如果当前趋势不扭转，到2050年俄罗斯人口将和也门差不多大。

ex.s: Southbank, at an eastern bend in the Thames, is the center of British skateboarding, where the continuous crashing of skateboards left your head ringing .I loved it.
ex.t: 南岸，在泰晤士河向东的拐弯处，是英国滑板运动的中心，滑板不断的撞击声让你的脑袋嗡嗡作响。我爱上了那里。

defs.def: a curve or turn, especially in a road or river （尤指道路或河流的）拐弯，弯道

ex.s: An adventure in Africa 3o June, Morocco My parents and I had just driven down the narrow mountain road from Marrakesh, with all its sharp bends, and had finally arrived at Merzouga.
ex.t: 非洲的一次冒险 6月30日，摩洛哥 我和父母刚刚沿着蜿蜒狭窄的山路从马拉喀什开下来，终于到达了梅尔祖加。

defs.def: severe pain and difficulty in breathing experienced by a diver who comes back to the surface of the water too quickly （潜水员过快浮出水面造成的）减压病，潜涵病

ex.s: The pressures of "time" and "destination" are further blocks to awareness． I encountered many hikers who were headed to a distant camp﹣ground with just enough time to get there before dark． It seldom occurred to them to wander a bit， to take a moment to see what's around them． I asked them what they'd seen． "Oh， a few birds， "they said． They seemed bent on their destinations．
ex.t: “时间”和“目的地”的压力是觉察的进一步阻碍。我遇到许多徒步者，他们赶往远处营地，时间刚好够天黑前到达。他们很少想到逛一逛，花点时间看看周围。我问他们看到了什么。“哦，几只鸟，”他们说。他们似乎一心奔着目的地。
